function.name: list_object_history_versions
function.description: List all recorded versions of a CMS object by its name or ID and its store or table name.

nameOrId.description: CMS object name or GUID ID.

storeName.description: CMS store name. Provide either storeName or tableName, but not both.

tableName.description: Dynamic table name. Provide either tableName or storeName, but not both.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
